Mega Man: Dual Override - 2nd Trailer - Proto Man Gameplay
Proto Man returns as a playable character, joining his brother in Mega Man: Dual Override! Witness some of Proto Man's unique abilities in the latest trailer, including Custom Chips, close combat techniques, and a powerful Override to overwhelm enemies.
 
Mega Man: Dual Override will launch on XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One and XBOX on PC in Spring 2027. Stay tuned for more updates!
